title: How to clean a dog bowl

pieces.say: Touch your dog's water bowl. Feel that slime?
pieces.text: Touch your dog's water bowl. Feel that slime?
pieces.label: GROSS ALERT

pieces.say: That's biofilm. Wash it every day.
Scrub with hot soapy water and a brush.
Rinse well, or run it through the dishwasher.
Rinse off all soap, and never mix cleaners.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
